scope: isolated internal-disk MySQL, 80000 synthetic orders, real order HTTP handler and SQL; 1/6 orders, 5/6 lightweight DB probes; 32 HTTP threads, 6 DB connections; no production workload or network
measurement_note: peak_pending_futures counts unfinished/uncollected client futures, not measured simultaneous HTTP in-flight requests; the separate burst test measures actual client in-flight calls.
